descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 20 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# Embrace your inner chef!

Learn and master different recipes in Ancient Greek, Song Dynasty Chinese, and Mayan kitchens.. Lost Recipes is an award-winning VR cooking experience for families, history fans, and curious chefs. Guided by native-speaking ghost chefs from each civilization, this game is a satisfying and realistic cooking experience, without the hurry or the clean-up!

**Highlights**

♦ Cook in traditional kitchens across ancient Greek, Chinese, and Maya civilizations 

[media]

♦ Learn the cooking styles and techniques of those civilizations from ghosts who want to pass down their recipes; move to the next recipe by meeting their expectations

♦ Hone your skills as a master chef to earn 5 stars in meal preparation, presentation, and process

♦ Enjoy the relaxing nature of this satisfying experience; you are rewarded by taking your time and completing each recipe as accurately as possible

[media]

♦ Immerse yourself with native-speaking voice actors and the extensive cultural and historical research that makes each kitchen feel as authentic as possible

Bonus! Cook these recipes in your own kitchen with the Lost Recipes cookbook. It is available for download at lostrecipesvr.com.

- Gold Winner: International Serious Play Awards K-12
